correctness.rationale: The source formula becomes a polynomial parametrization in \(x=1/m\). The coordinate polynomials have pairwise distinct lowest degrees \(0,1,\ldots,n-1\), so they form a basis of the degree-at-most-\(n-1\) polynomial space. For \(n\ge3\), the quadratic \(-\left(x-1/m_0\right)^2\) is therefore a linear functional of the probability vector and uniquely exposes the finite point \(m_0\); \(-x\) exposes the limiting point. The converse extreme-point inclusion follows directly from the definition of a convex hull as finite convex combinations.
